subject: CardinalPay onboarding — prioritization request for merchant onboarding features
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elle Zhao <elle.zhao@cardinalpay.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CardinalPay onboarding — prioritization request for merchant onboarding features

Team —

Summary: CardinalPay (large issuer network, closing end of May) just confirmed they will move forward if we can commit to a short list of onboarding features for merchant activation. They asked for a prioritized plan by EOD Friday so procurement can align the SOW and timelines.

Critical asks from CardinalPay:
- Enterprise SSO + SCIM (IdP provisioning) — must be in pilot (not full GA)
- Tenant-level audit logs + 1y retention export (for their compliance team)
- Tenant isolation controls (ability to pin routing and data residency)
- Onboarding throughput guarantee for batch merchant onboarding (peak 10k merchants/day)

What we need from Product/Eng: can we scope an MVP for these that fits a Q2 delivery commitment for pilot? If not, provide the minimal subset we can commit to and suggested fallback (e.g., scoped SSO + audit export, isolate routing as a config flag later).

Attachments: feature spreadsheet and draft SOW attached.

Why it matters: this is a net-new enterprise account (estimated $1.2M ARR first year) and Procurement has a strict timeline — they will pull the signature if we can’t secure the pilot scope. Marissa is on the thread for commercial constraints.

Ask to Product/Eng: please reply with: (1) feasibility note (2) proposed priority order and (3) blockers/risks by EOD Friday 4/09.

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Principal Sales Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0192

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elle Zhao <elle.zhao@cardinalpay.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 12:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CardinalPay onboarding — prioritization request for merchant onboarding features

Thanks Sean — looping in engineering. Quick triage/questions before we scope:

1) SSO + SCIM: do they need just authentication (SSO) for admin users or also SCIM provisioning for merchants/users? The sheet mixes both. If they need full SCIM provisioning that's an extra integration surface.
2) Audit logs retention: are exports acceptable (manual/periodic) for pilot, or do they require a live streaming export into their SIEM?
3) Tenant isolation: do they expect hard network-level isolation or logical isolation (config + routing pinning)?
4) Throughput: the 10k merchants/day — is that parallel activation across many small merchants or large individual merchant onboarding bulk? We need example payload sizes.

Initial thinking (very high level):
- MVP prioritization: (A) SSO (admin SSO) + SCIM-lite (provisioning of admin accounts only), (B) Audit log export CSV + one-time export job with 1y retention, (C) Routing pinning (config flag) for tenant isolation, (D) Throughput optimizations — likely requires Dedicated capacity commit or streaming ingestion work.

We can probably get (A) and (B) into an engineering backlog sprint for a pilot by end of May if we deprioritize lower-risk roadmap items. (C) is medium effort but could be delivered as a configuration gating for pilot. (D) depends heavily on Dedicated capacity + autoscale policy; we’ll need capacity commit in the deal to guarantee 10k/day.

Jordan — can you do a quick engineering estimate on (A)-(C) by EOD Friday? If we get a green light, we’ll draft a minimal product spec and break into workstreams.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Product Lead, Onboarding & Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elle Zhao <elle.zhao@cardinalpay.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@cardinalpay.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CardinalPay onboarding — prioritization request for merchant onboarding features

Adding color from the customer:
- Procurement timeline: CardinalPay procurement calendar is tight — they want an internal SOW signed and pilot kickoff by 5/20 to hit their holiday merchant onboarding window.
- SCIM: they explicitly want merchant provisioning to be automated eventually; for pilot they are willing to accept admin-only SCIM if we commit to merchant provisioning roadmap in writing.
- Audit logs: Procurement will accept daily export of audit logs pushed to their S3 bucket for pilot, but they want our retention policy documented in SOW.
- Throughput: bulk onboarding is CSV-based with ~2–3MB per merchant payload on average; their 10k/day is a mix of small merchants so parallelism is what matters.

I attached a lightweight business note (CardinalPay_MVP_feature_list.xlsx) and the draft SOW we circulated earlier. We need clear bullets from Product/Eng we can push into SOW (accepted pilot scope + known exclusions).

One more ask — if engineering needs a procurement sign-off for Dedicated capacity commitment, we should surface the exact capacity number they want so Finance can model it into the SOW.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Exec
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Elle Zhao <elle.zhao@cardinalpay.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 15:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CardinalPay onboarding — prioritization request for merchant onboarding features

Thanks — did a quick engineering pass on scope and risks.

Feasibility (rough):
- SSO (admin) + SCIM-lite (admin provisioning): LOW effort (2 devs, ~2 weeks including test matrix).
- Audit log daily export to S3 + 1y retention policy: LOW-MED effort (1 backend dev + infra work to add export job + docs, ~3 weeks).
- Routing pinning / logical tenant isolation (config flag + routing rule): MED effort (3 devs, ~3–5 weeks) — requires changes to routing policy + tests across Dedicated and Hosted fallback.
- Throughput guarantee (10k merchants/day): HIGH effort — depends on Dedicated capacity sizing and warmup; we need a minimum Dedicated commit (estimate: 8 x A100-equivalent nodes for peak windows) OR staged onboarding with controlled concurrency.

Proposed pilot scope (what we can commit to for SOW delivery by 5/20):
1) Admin SSO + SCIM-lite (pilot-ready) — deliverable for pilot.
2) Daily audit log export to CardinalPay S3 with 1y retention documented — deliverable for pilot.
3) Routing pinning as alpha config flag — aim to include in pilot but mark as alpha in SOW (known limitations documented).

Blockers/asks from Sales:
- Procurement must include a Dedicated capacity commit or accept a staged onboarding plan with explicit concurrency limits.
- Headcount: need 1 additional QA cycle reserved in sprint for tenant isolation tests.

If Sales can confirm capacity commitment by next Tue (4/13), we can finalize an internal sprint plan and give dates for each deliverable. If not, we should offer CardinalPay a staged approach in the SOW (A+B now; C+D in Q3).

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference
